title: Nova Scotia: Navy divers see occupants beside two saucers on the seabed

tellings.quote: these divers claimed uh that they saw UFO fo occupants outside these two saucers on the on the seabed and and and that they even took video of it

plain: In 1960, off Nova Scotia in Canada, Navy divers are said to have seen the occupants of two flying saucers standing outside their craft on the seabed, and even to have filmed them, during an operation the tellers call Sweep Clear Five. A retired US Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet passes this on from the researchers Chris Styles and Brian Fitzpatrick, who looked into the case. If true, it would mean military divers met visitors face to face under the ocean.
